## Release Notes for the Latest Version of Disruption March 6, 2025

The Network360 Team is excited to share the latest updates designed to enhance your user experience on the Disruption platform.

Here’s what’s new in this release:

1. Activity Stream Logging Now Tracks More Activities

   * CSV Export Logging

   * Matching Configuration Logging

   * Column Aliases Logging

   * Cancel Activity Logging

   * Rerun Activity Logging

2.	Improved TaxID Formatting for Better Matching Consistency

Key Highlights

1.	Activity stream Logging Now Tracks More Activities

What’s New: 

Logging has now been fully implemented for additional key actions across the platform, including:

•	CSV Export Logging: Tracks and allows direct downloads of standardized original files, QA output files, provider CSV reports, original imported files, and detailed analysis reports.

•	Matching Configuration Logging: Logs admin actions (create, edit, duplicate, view) and non-admin views of matching configurations, with visibility based on sharing settings.

•	Column Aliases Logging: Logs actions related to creating, editing, and deleting column aliases.

•	Cancel Activity Logging: Logs cancellations of processing files, utilization files, and analysis jobs, providing a clear record for easy tracking.

•	Rerun Activity Logging: Tracks all rerun activities for utilization files, processing files, and analysis jobs, ensuring better traceability.

 

How This Helps:

•	This new logging ensures better tracking and visibility for users, allowing you to easily access and review actions related to CSV exports, matching configurations, column aliases, canceled tasks, and rerun activities.

2.	Improved TaxID Formatting for Better Matching Consistency

What’s New:

•	TaxIDs in utilization files will now be formatted consistently to ensure more accurate matching.

How This Helps:

•	This improvement ensures that TaxIDs are processed in a consistent format, improving match accuracy and overall data quality.

 Conclusion

These updates bring valuable improvements to your Disruption platform experience, including newly implemented activity stream logging for more key actions and enhanced TaxID formatting for better matching consistency.

We are committed to continuous improvement. If you have any questions or need support, feel free to reach out.
